hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 1; v=$(just --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d " " -f 2); if [ -n "$v" ] && [ "$(printf "%s\n" 1.42.3 "$v" | sort -V | head -n 1)" = 1.42.3 ]; then just install; else uvx --from 'rust-just>=1.42.3' just install; fi
